# Assets

Images for the template's README and GitHub page. Task repos made from the template do not need this folder; the README's quick start removes it.

| File | Used by | Size |
|---|---|---|
| `demo.gif` | the README, under the badges | 1000×560, about 20 seconds |
| `social-preview.png` | Settings → General → Social preview (uploaded by hand; GitHub has no API for it) | 1280×640 |
| `render_assets.py` | renders both files | |

## Rendering

```bash
pip install pillow
python .github/assets/render_assets.py
```

The script draws both images with Pillow from the lists at its top, so nothing is recorded or generated by a paid service.

## Keeping the demo honest

`DEMO` in `render_assets.py` replays commands and outputs from [cerredz/vidbyte-memory-example](https://github.com/cerredz/vidbyte-memory-example): the owner's words as logged in its `memory/feedback-log.md`, its test names, its pytest results and its footprint commit subjects. `CARD_COMMIT`, the commit line on the social preview, is one of those subjects too. When the example's history changes, edit the lists to match it and render again. Never edit them to show something the example did not do.
